# SolPulseData - Solana On-Chain Telemetry API (x402)
Base URL: https://solpulsedata.duckdns.org
Network: solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp (Solana Mainnet)
Asset: USDC (EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v)
PayTo: EdW5Po6qGC3KxcAyugYHrBC891ctL54UMseWaqaLugV6
Facilitator: https://facilitator.payai.network
Discovery: https://solpulsedata.duckdns.org/.well-known/x402.json
OpenAPI: https://solpulsedata.duckdns.org/openapi.json

Data Notes:
- Computed market telemetry and historical technical indicators only. Not financial, investment, or trading advice.
- Hourly candles accumulate in SQLite; RSI-14 requires 15 candles (active at 54 candles), while SMA-200 requires 200 candles (null until warmup completes).

## Free Endpoints
- GET /health - Service liveness, payment gate status, network, and tracked symbols.
- GET /v1/sample - Free sample payload and response schema preview.

## Paid Endpoints (x402 v2 via PayAI on Solana Mainnet)
- GET /v1/levels?symbol=SOL - Price (USDC), 72h floor/ceiling, RSI-14, SMA-200, dip score, and warmup_complete ($0.01 USDC / 10000 atomic units).
- GET /v1/dipscan?min_score=60 - Deterministic dip score scan across tracked Solana pools ($0.02 USDC / 20000 atomic units).
- GET /v1/cycle - Deterministic Bitcoin block-halving cycle progress telemetry ($0.005 USDC / 5000 atomic units).
